outcome: Magnitude of fall in mean arterial pressure
cohort: The study included 150 parturients undergoing lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Co-administration of 75 mcg phenylephrine with 3U oxytocin was associated with a lower incidence of hypotension, lower magnitude of fall in mean arterial pressure, and lower rescue vasopressor requirement compared to co-administration of 5 mg ephedrine with 3U oxytocin or oxytocin 3U with normal saline in parturients undergoing LSCS under spinal anesthesia.
